title: Reading Drill — Checking a portable exhibition ramp — Preparing a second trial
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Checking a portable exhibition ramp — Preparing a second trial
passages.body:
**A** In Foxhaven, work on visitors slowing down at the top of the ramp had already produced a small collection of observations at each entrance. The event access volunteer used this material to plan a second trial. The first report contained several different figures, but for the second trial the group agreed to publish one main outcome: time to enter the room.

**B** The group kept a level resting area for the new trial, which was planned to run for four weeks. Volunteers were shown a sample record before starting. They were also asked to describe anything unusual in a separate note, so later readers could tell the difference between an ordinary value and one taken during a disruption.

**C** The trial design stated that the weight of peoples' bags should be recorded even when everything else appeared normal. If this information was missing, the team would leave the field blank rather than infer an answer. It would publish a provisional finding and label it clearly if too few readings were available for a reliable result.
